music.title: Bohemian Rhapsody

producer.name: Roy Thomas Baker
producer.bio: Roy Thomas Baker is an English record producer known for his work with Queen, The Cars, and Journey.

writer.bio: Freddie Mercury was a British singer, songwriter, and record producer, best known as the lead vocalist of the rock band Queen.

music.description: Bohemian Rhapsody is a six-minute suite by the British rock band Queen, written by Freddie Mercury for the album A Night at the Opera. The song has no chorus but consists of several sections: an intro, a ballad segment, an operatic passage, a hard rock part, and a reflective coda. It became one of the best-selling singles of all time and is widely regarded as one of the greatest songs in the history of rock music.
